name: pdf_form
description: Generate a fillable PDF form (text, checkbox, choice, listbox fields plus static labels) from a field list. Writes to a new output file.

fields.description: Field objects: {type: text|checkbox|choice|listbox|label, name, x, y, width, height, value, options, label}. Origin is bottom-left, in points.

title.description: Optional title drawn at the top.
